department: Institute of Physics (IoP), Faculty of Science

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to an advertised vacancy (each has its own deadline) or send an open application to a research school or supervisor
deadline.quote: There are several ways to obtain a PhD position. You can apply for a vacancy or submit an open application.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: An authorised supervisor (with the right to award doctorates) must agree to accept you; a second supervisor is always appointed
supervisor.quote: You can only pursue a PhD at the UvA once an authorised supervisor has agreed to accept you as a PhD candidate. | In addition to the principal supervisor, a second supervisor must always be appointed.

funding.value: Vacancy positions are salaried UvA employment; an open application may come without UvA funding, in which case you need a grant, scholarship, employer or your own money
funding.quote: Option 1: Apply for a vacancy | If you are selected, you will be employed by the UvA and receive a salary. | If your application is successful, you may in some cases be employed by the UvA. In other cases, you may not receive funding from the UvA.

entry_route.value: A recognised Dutch master's degree or a comparable foreign qualification; the Doctorate Board assesses foreign degrees, and not every foreign master's is enough
entry_route.quote: You meet the degree requirement if you hold a recognised and accredited Dutch Master’s degree or a comparable foreign qualification. | Not every foreign Master’s programme is sufficient for admission.

notes: These are UvA-wide pages; the Institute of Physics lists its PhD openings through the UvA vacancies site. The admission page requires 'a good command of English' and says a faculty or institute may add language requirements; no test minimum was found.
